releaseName: Learn your writing preferences from review
summary: One sprint since the Prepare panel (milestone 73). DraftLoop now notices what the candidate keeps changing in review and suggests it as a writing preference: a word removed from at least 3 drafts across at least 2 applications becomes a forbidden term, and a section order approved as often becomes the policy's order (#2251, #2252). Each suggestion shows its reason; accepting one saves a new writing-policy version, and dismissing one means it is never offered again (#2253, #2265). Suggestions appear under Workspace settings on Home, in the API and with `draft-loop preferences`. A new memory model page and domain catalog name every kind of memory a run uses (#2249, #2250). Skipped and unknown interview answers now stay in transcript evidence, so each answer stays with its question (#2256). The engine can emit content-free run spans through a tracing port (#1102).
knownLimitations: Suggestions cover forbidden words and section order only; dismissed critic findings are counted but do not change the critic yet (#2254). Approval edits replace block text, so a section order suggestion comes from revisions the candidate steered, not from edits. Run spans are not stored or exported yet (#1103, #1104).
